instruction.name: rcri.d
instruction.description: x86-style rotate right through carry by immediate on 64-bit values.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: rcri.d $r12, $r4, 1; rcri.d $r13, $r5, 1; rcri.d $r14, $r6, 1; rcri.d $r15, $r7, 1; rcri.d $r16, $r8, 1; rcri.d $r17, $r9, 1; rcri.d $r18, $r10, 1; rcri.d $r19, $r11, 1
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8' --asm 'rcri.d $r12, $r4, 1; rcri.d $r13, $r5, 1; rcri.d $r14, $r6, 1; rcri.d $r15, $r7, 1; rcri.d $r16, $r8, 1; rcri.d $r17, $r9, 1; rcri.d $r18, $r10, 1; rcri.d $r19, $r11, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.63 cycles. Measured CPI 1.0788; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 1. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LBT instruction. Only the register source feeds the result.
